items.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
items.summary: OpenAI President Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
items.summary: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.
items.creator: Connie Loizos

items.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
items.summary: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
items.summary: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.
items.creator: Sean O'Kane

items.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
items.summary: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal
